themes.title: Legal Pushback Against Right‑Wing Executive Power
themes.blurb: Across the US and Scandinavia, courts, committees and opposition parties are mounting legal and procedural challenges to actions taken by right‑wing governments or officials, signaling a transnational pattern of institutional resistance to executive overreach.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: US courts ruled on the Trump administration’s loyalty‑test for hires, immigration detention policy, and the legality of using public funds for political ads.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Sweden Democrats faced parliamentary scrutiny and media disputes over alleged misuse of political influence and coalition negotiations.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Norwegian committee leader criticized insufficient answers during the Epstein hearing, demanding clearer accountability.
